_comment: User configuration overrides - copy to user_configs/app_config.json (gitignored) and keep only what you change. The tracked baseline is configs/app_config.json, with every credential blank and disabled; this file is merged over it key by key.
_rules: A live credential belongs here and never in the tracked baseline. Everything below is a placeholder.

api._comment: One entry per consumer, so revoking one does not disturb the others. A 403 from a route means the grant is missing; a 401 means the token itself is unknown here.

collector_watch.token: <40 hex characters - docs/operations/watching_a_collector.md says how to generate one>
collector_watch.note: python -m python.main watch - the status shell. One route and nothing else: it sits open on a desk all day.

operator.note: Diagnostics from a session - archive listings, log excerpts, file transfers.
